name: OctoberWEEN Special 2017
source:
After almost dying from a sharp metal object found inside your stomach because of a chocolate snack produced by a certain company. The company decided to settle it outside of court and so gave you a hella lot of money.

It's halloween and you, your sister and her friend are going out to get some treats and along the way... Things happen.
translation:
因食用某公司生产的巧克力零食而在胃内发现尖锐的金属物体，差点丧命。公司决定庭外和解，所以给了你一大笔钱。

万圣节到了，你、你的妹妹和她的朋友要出去吃点东西，一路上……事情发生了。
